text:
Maria Chen: FYI customer ACME reported p99 latency jumps on /v1/generate since 11:10 UTC, started after canary deploy.
Devin Patel: Looking at metrics — cluster 'eu-west-1-a' shows KV cache miss rate up from 3% -> 42% at 11:09.
Cheng Wu: Any error logs? Could be key normalization bug (session id vs user id keys).
Maria Chen: Logs attached: 
```
[11:09:12] cache.get(kv:prefix:session:abcd1234) MISS
[11:09:12] cache.put(kv:prefix:session:abcd1234)
[11:09:12] cache.evict(candidate=k:prefix:session:xyz789)
[11:09:12] req id=rid-9b8 latency=230ms
```
Olivia Grant: I see alternating puts/evicts for same prefixes — looks like warmup thrash when many short-lived session keys hit.
Devin Patel: Repro steps I ran locally: spawn 300 clients with random session ids hitting same model -> steady-state miss increases and p99 spikes.
Cheng Wu: Can you paste the repro script? Also what's the eviction policy? LRU with shard-level capacity 10k.
Devin Patel: Script (abridged):
```
for i in {1..300}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"session_id":"sess-'$RANDOM'","prompt":"hi"}' &
done
```
support-bot: Noted customer SLA hit, ticket #INC-4821 created.
Maria Chen: Immediate mit: reduce shard eviction aggressiveness, ramp TTL for prefix keys from 60s -> 5m, and enable sticky key mode for sessions.
Olivia Grant: Sticky key mode might increase memory but should cut warmup. Also propose prefix canonicalization fix — current header parsing includes `x-session-id` and `session` query param alternately.
Cheng Wu: I'll push a quick config rollback to the canary and add a hotfix for key normalization. On call will monitor.
sre-bot: Deploy started: rollback canary -> previous-runtime-config (deployed by Cheng Wu) at 11:25 UTC
Devin Patel: After rollback miss rate dropped to 6% and p99 returned to baseline within 90s.
Maria Chen: Action items: 
- Cheng: PR for canonicalize-prefix-keys (add deterministic normalization)
- Olivia: Run memory/model cost calc for TTL 5m change
- Devin: Add unit test reproducing session-key churn
- Support: update customer with mitigation and ETA
Olivia Grant: I'll also add a temporary runtime knob `cache.warmup.drip` to spread warmups over 10s.
support-bot: Customer updated: workaround applied, SLA remediation planned.
Maria Chen: Thanks team — follow-up retro tomorrow, record in postmortems channel.
